d.ko: 스타 보드게임 디자이너 Stefan Feld가 만든 유명 Ravensburger 보드 게임입니다.
d.en: Stefan Feld's highly decorated board game "The Castles Of Burgundy" by Ravensburger is getting its digital version on Steam! Enjoy against the challenging AI or friends a beautiful digital version of the classic board game!
d.zh: Ravensburger的这款知名桌游出自明星设计师Stefan Feld之手。
